remarks: Original owner custom mid-century masterpiece! Offered for the very first time by the family who custom-built it, 87 Surrey Run is a pristine 3 bedroom, 2.5 bathroom architectural gem. Located in the highly sought-after Williamsville School District, this historic property perfectly blends vintage high design with major modern upgrades. As an added bonus for mid-century enthusiasts, the sale includes the original custom blueprints and plans. The immaculate interior was custom curated by renowned designer Florence Cooper, showcasing beautiful hardwood floors throughout the main living spaces. The formal dining room is a showstopper, adorned with prestigious Van Luit and custom hand-screened wallpapers. For cozy gatherings, the massive family room serves as a spectacular focal point, anchored by a dramatic full brick-wall fireplace. Enjoy ultimate peace of mind with a brand new architectural roof (November 2025) and a fully updated electrical system. Abundant storage throughout includes multiple deep walk in closets and spectacular cedar closets. An exceptional lower level offers a nostalgic, knotty pine finished basement boasting rare, comfortable 8 foot ceilings. Complete with a built in bar and grill, this expansive area serves as the ultimate vintage entertainment hub. Outside, find an exceptionally large backyard oasis, featuring a gorgeous flagstone patio equipped with a Kohler awning frame. The entire yard is completely enclosed by a premium, solid redwood fence for unmatched privacy. A spacious 2-car attached garage and all included appliances complete this move-in-ready package. Seller reserves right to set offer deadline.
